notes:
61 foods. Structure: (1) 「体を温める食べ物と栄養素」節 L88-102 = 6 warm foods, each with its own subheading (生姜 L91 / ねぎ L93 / 鶏むね肉 L95 / かぼちゃ L97 / みかん L99 / 豚レバー L101). みかん and 豚レバー carry no explicit warm sentence of their own — they are coded warm from the enclosing section heading 「体を温める食べ物と栄養素」, which the source itself equates with 陽性 (L90). (2) 「体を冷やす食べ物」節 L107-114 = 陰性 list, 42 foods across six bullet lines. (3) 「見分け方」節 L115-120 adds 13 more attributions in running prose that a list-only extractor would miss: 肉/赤身の魚/人参/ごぼう/根菜類/味噌 (陽性, L118), 白米/砂糖 (cool, L120), 玄米/黒糖/てんさい糖/ハチミツ (陽性の食材, L120), 生野菜 (体を冷やしやすい, L120).

Decisions and flags:
- 玄米/てんさい糖/ハチミツ ARE coded warm here, unlike the §8 basefood precedent, because this source states an explicit nature attribution (「陽性の食材です」) before the substitution advice; it is not substitute-recommendation context alone.
- The six bullet labels 穀物・豆類 / 肉 / 魚介類 / 野菜 / 果物 / 調味料 (L109-114) were NOT coded as umbrella attributions: they are taxonomic partitions of one list, not categories the source assigns a direction to. Coding them would also make 野菜 cool while L118 calls 冬が旬の野菜 warm.
- CONTRADICTION inside the source: 肉 is 陽性 at L118 while 馬肉/鴨肉/動物性脂肪 sit under the 陰性 「肉」 bullet at L110. Both coded as stated; no reconciliation attempted.
- 生野菜 (L120) coded cool as a food state (raw vs cooked), not a serving temperature.
- 薬用養命酒 (L134-138, 「体全体をしっかりと温めます」) NOT coded: it is a 第2類医薬品 product, i.e. a prepared/medicinal preparation rather than a food's nature (§8 白湯/生姜湯 precedent).
- 生姜 has a cooking condition at L92 (「生姜を加熱すると…体を温める効果が高くなります」) but the source never assigns raw 生姜 a cooling direction, so it is a single warm row, not a raw/cooked split.
- L118 also assigns warm to non-food descriptors (寒い地域でとれるもの / 冬が旬の野菜 / 地中でまっすぐ育つもの) and L120 to their cool counterparts (暑い地域でとれるもの / 夏が旬の野菜 / 土より上に育つもの); these are heuristics, not named foods, so they are not coded.
- The whole upper part of the file (L1-60) is site navigation from other articles (芍薬, サンザシ, 桂皮, そうめん…); those titles carry no warm/cool attribution and are not coded.
